notes.title: Moving Day 1.3 - Achievements Update
notes.content:
Today we have released version 1.3  of moving day.

This update includes some minor bug fixes as well as adding Achievements!

Release Notes

[list]
[*] Steamworks support added
[*] 6 New Achievements Added (1 for each ending)
[*] Fixed some minor issues causing extended load times
[*] Fixed the level of the doll on the first floor hallway so the player can now interact with it.
[*] Hint added to help with the Library Puzzle
[list]
